caption: The overlap is mutual information I(X;Y); the two outer parts are the conditional entropies H(X|Y) and H(Y|X). Notice that I is contained in both H(X) and H(Y).

spec.aria: Venn diagram of the source entropy H(X) and output entropy H(Y) whose overlap is the mutual information I(X;Y), with H(X|Y) and H(Y|X) in the non-overlapping parts.
